facts.fact: The Kenyan government's State Department for Social Protection pays Inua Jamii cash-transfer stipends (older persons, orphans and vulnerable children, severe disability, plus HSNP) into bank accounts through six contracted payment service providers, monthly from July 2023.
The government mandated mobile money payments from December 2023, piloted for the CT-OVC and PwSD-CT programmes to augment bank payments.

systems.platform: choice model of six contracted PSPs, bank accounts; mobile money pilot
